name: claude-code-setup
description: Mods for Claude Code: an agent and token board, command toasts, a big-read guard, done notifications, plus two vendored Anthropic samples.

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Docked board: token usage (context, 5h and weekly limits, per model) and an on-demand details view for each subagent.

plugins.name: cmd-toast
plugins.description: Toasts and a live status line only for background and long-running shell commands.

plugins.name: big-read-guard
plugins.description: Blocks whole-file reads of huge or generated files.

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notification when a long turn finishes.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change (Anthropic sample, Apache-2.0).
